description: Implementation of the KeyIdMap class managing key session IDs and associated key IDs with thread safety, including methods to add, update, retrieve, and erase key sessions.

classes.name: KeyIdMap
classes.description: A singleton class that manages mapping between key session IDs and their corresponding key IDs, ensuring thread safety with mutex locking.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the KeyIdMap class.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new key session ID with an empty key ID vector.

methods.name: updateKey
methods.description: Updates the key ID associated with a given session ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID associated with a given session ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a key session ID and its associated key ID from the map.
